title: ExtractedStatement
description: Cross-layer statement schema for a single extracted relationship triple. Used as the Layer 2 output format (always silver on first write), and reused by Layer 5 when updating epistemic_tier. The predicate field discriminates the required structure of the attributes object and the binary/unary nature of the triple.

entity_id.description: Neo4j node ID or provisional slug if not yet persisted. Format: ENT-{canonical_slug}.

canonical_name.description: The canonical name from Layer A taxonomy or Layer B alias resolution.

raw_mention.description: Exact string as it appeared in the source before alias resolution.

alias_resolved.description: Whether raw_mention required alias resolution to reach canonical_name.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema used to produce this record.

epistemic_tier.description: Epistemic tier of this record. Layer 2 always writes 'silver'. Layer 5 may update to 'gold' on promotion or retain 'silver' after failed admissibility check.

predicate.description: The relationship type. Discriminates the required structure of the attributes object and whether object is required or forbidden.

family.description: Relationship family. Derivable from predicate, but stored explicitly for efficient downstream filtering and family-specific Layer 5 logic.

object.description: Object entity of the triple. MUST be omitted for measurement predicates (PRICES, EMPLOYS, EMITS). MUST be present and valid for all other predicates. Enforced by allOf conditions below.

extraction_type.description: Direct: explicitly stated. Inferred: derived from context, calculation, or implication.

source_entity_id.description: Layer 1 bronze entity from which this was extracted. Format: DOC-{id}-P{page:03d}-E{seq:04d}.

source_chunk_id.description: Text chunk or table row within the entity. For non-text entities, equals source_entity_id.

raw_text.description: Verbatim source text or table cell content. For chart extraction, this is the chart title and any axis labels that support the extraction.

table_row_index.description: For table_extraction: 0-based row index within the source table entity.

inferred_from.description: For inferred extractions: brief description of the inference chain.

scope.description: Scope dimensions. First-class semantic content, not metadata. Used for contradiction detection, admissibility, and query-time truth ranking. Two records with different scope dimensions are NOT contradictory — they are measuring different things. Omit material_form and metric_basis for structural/atemporal relationships where they are not applicable. Use null when applicable but unknown.

material_form.description: Omit for structural/atemporal relationships (LOCATED_IN, MEMBER_OF, etc.). Null means applicable but not determinable from source. E.g., 'contained_metal', 'spodumene_concentrate', 'lithium_carbonate_equivalent', 'rare_earth_oxide'.

metric_basis.description: Omit for structural/atemporal relationships. Null means applicable but not determinable. E.g., 'production_volume', 'refining_output', 'export_volume', 'capacity_nameplate', 'capacity_actual', 'reserves', 'consumption'.

geographic_scope.description: Use 'not_applicable' for atemporal structural relationships such as MEMBER_OF where geography is meaningless.

temporal_scope.description: The time period this statement describes. Use ISO 8601-based strings: calendar_year_2023, fiscal_year_2023_jun, Q3_2024, monthly_2024_01, cumulative, atemporal, as_of_2024_06.

reporting_basis.description: How the reporter defines or produces the metric. Null if not determinable. Note: provenance class (primary vs secondary) is captured separately in data_source_basis.

data_source_basis.description: Provenance class of the source document for this statement.

attributes.description: Relationship-specific attributes. The required fields within this object depend on the predicate value and requirement class (S/A/G/C) defined in taxonomy/layer_a/relationships.md. S-class fields are enforced by allOf conditions below. A-class and G-class fields are documented in the ontology but not schema-enforced here — they are evaluated by Layer 5 admissibility logic and reflected in the completeness block. Omit unpopulated optional fields rather than setting them to null.

completeness.description: Completeness assessment against S/A/G requirement classes. Populated by Layer 2 at extraction time. Used by Layer 5 as input to tier promotion decisions. Note: gold_precheck_satisfied is a local schema/field completeness check only — Layer 5 makes the final gold promotion decision based on additional criteria (contradiction status, ambiguity resolution, source credibility).

structural_satisfied.description: All S-class fields are present. If false, Layer 6 must not persist this record.

analytical_satisfied.description: All A-class fields are present. If false, the record is stored as silver but flagged as analytically incomplete.

gold_precheck_satisfied.description: All S+A+G fields are present and all required scope dimensions are populated. True means this record is a candidate for gold promotion — it does not mean Layer 5 will promote it.

missing_structural_fields.description: S-class fields that are missing. Non-empty means structural_satisfied=false and record must not be persisted.

missing_analytical_fields.description: A-class fields that are missing. Non-empty means analytical_satisfied=false.

missing_gold_fields.description: G-class fields that are missing. Non-empty means gold_precheck_satisfied=false.

evidence_packet_id.description: Reference to the associated evidence packet stored separately. Format: STEP-{doc_id}-P{page:03d}-REL-{seq:04d}.

lineage.description: Processing provenance. Identifies exactly which taxonomy version, model versions, skill versions, and conversion factors produced this record. Required for targeted re-processing when any of these are updated.

taxonomy_version.description: Semantic version of taxonomy/layer_a at time of extraction.

conversion_factors_used.description: Conversion factors applied during extraction (e.g., unit normalisation). Empty array if none.

model_versions.description: Model identifiers used in this extraction step.

ambiguity_flags.description: Ambiguities detected during extraction that could not be resolved inline. Each entry is routed to Layer 3 (Ambiguity Resolution Service). Empty array if no ambiguities.

field.description: The field path that is affected, e.g., 'subject.entity_id', 'attributes.metric'.

blocking.description: If true, Layer 6 must not persist this record until Layer 3 resolves it. If false, the record can be persisted as silver with this flag attached.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this statement record was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last update. Present only when Layer 5 modifies this record (tier promotion, scope correction, ambiguity resolution).

allOf.$comment: UNARY / BINARY enforcement. Measurement predicates (PRICES, EMPLOYS, EMITS) must NOT include an object entity. All other predicates MUST include an object entity.
FAMILY consistency: structural predicates must have family=structural.
FAMILY consistency: transactional predicates must have family=transactional.
S-CLASS enforcement: PRICES requires price, currency, unit_basis, date in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: EMPLOYS requires headcount in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: EMITS requires emission_type, value, unit in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: HAS_CAPACITY requires capacity, unit in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: RESERVES requires volume, unit in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: IMPORTS, EXPORTS, SUPPLIES, HAS_SUPPLY_AGREEMENT require commodity in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: PROCESSES_AT_STAGE requires supply_chain_stage in attributes.
S-CLASS enforcement: DEPENDS_ON requires dependency_type in attributes (A-class but structurally load-bearing per ontology).
